use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Numerics.INumber
use System.Numerics.IMultiplyOperators.`*

power[T: INumber[T]](base: T, exponent: int) -> T =>
    if exponent == 0 then
        T.one
    elif exponent % 2 == 0 then
        let root = power(base, exponent / 2)

        root * root
    else
        base * power(base, exponent - 1)
    fi

let digits = power(5n, power(4, power(3, 2))).to_string()

write_line("first 20 digits: {digits[0..20]}")
write_line("last 20 digits:  {digits[20..<<0]}")
write_line("decimal digits:  {digits.length}")

use System.Numerics.IMultiplyOperators.`*

power[T: INumber[T]](base: T, exponent: int) -> T =>
    if exponent == 0 then

    elif exponent % 2 == 0 then
        let root = power(base, exponent / 2)

        root * root
    else
        base * power(base, exponent - 1)
    fi

let digits = power(5n, power(4, power(3, 2))).to_string()

write_line("first 20 digits: {digits[0..20]}")
